race.title: Moment For The Monastery Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Not the easiest race to assess but REALTA LIATH has a good record fresh and is also well handicapped on her Fontwell chasing debut win so gets the vote. Chasing newcomers Livingonaprayer and Crazierthandaisy bring potential and are in excellent hands so could emerge as the main dangers, especially if the betting speaks in their favour. REALTA LIATH (IRE) LIVINGONAPRAYER CRAZIERTHANDAISY
race.bettingForecast: Crazierthandaisy (5/2), Realta Liath (7/2), Kilworth (5/1), Livingonaprayer (6/1), Hill In Brazil (13/2), Regal Renaissance (8/1), Edith Pelham (10/1)
